title: Microsoft AI Releases MAI-Cyber-1-Flash: A 5B-Active-Parameter Cyber Model That Pushes MDASH to 95.95% on CyberGym
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: Microsoft AI has released MAI-Cyber-1-Flash, its first model built specifically for cyber defense. It is a 137B total, 5B active sparse MoE fine-tune of MAI-Code-1-Flash with a 256...
body: Microsoft AI has launched MAI-Cyber-1-Flash, a 5-billion active parameter model optimized for cybersecurity operations and vulnerability scanning. Trained on extensive threat intelligence datasets, the model assists security teams by analyzing network logs, identifying zero-day threat patterns, and suggesting remediation scripts. Its lightweight architecture allows for low-latency on-premise deployments. This tool empowers security analysts to triage threats faster and configure active defense mechanisms in real-time without relying on external APIs. It represents a critical addition to corporate security toolkits. The model is optimized to run efficiently on standard local workstations.
